summary: ACTOOS ONE - Wallet & Promo Supabase Integration Testing. Tested 5 features: (1) Login - PASS, (2) Wallet access - PASS with fallback, (3) TopUp flow - UI works but balance doesn't persist due to Supabase schema issue, (4) Promo Banner - PASS (5 promos loaded from Supabase), (5) Promo Code at Checkout - PASS (ACTOOS10 applied, -350 FCFA discount). Critical issue: Supabase wallets table missing 'wallet_type' column causing fallback to local wallet.

critical.issue: Column 'wallet_type' does not exist in wallets table. Error: {code: 42703, message: column wallets.wallet_type does not exist}. This causes WalletContext to use local fallback wallet with balance 0.

minor.issue: RPC function not available, code falls back to direct query which then fails due to missing column

integration_issues.issue: TopUp UI flow works correctly but balance doesn't persist because wallet uses local fallback due to Supabase schema issue

action_items: CRITICAL: Add 'wallet_type' column to Supabase wallets table. Run migration: ALTER TABLE wallets ADD COLUMN wallet_type VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'client';
Verify Supabase RPC function 'get_or_create_wallet' exists and is accessible
Consider adding 'update_wallet_balance' RPC function for atomic balance updates

context_for_next_testing_agent: Supabase promo_codes table is working (5 promos loaded). Supabase wallets table needs 'wallet_type' column added. WalletContext uses fallback local wallet when Supabase query fails. All UI flows work correctly.

test_2_wallet_access.details: ACTOOS Pay wallet screen displays correctly. Shows balance 0 FCFA (using local fallback due to Supabase schema issue). Buttons: Recharger, Envoyer, Payer, Encaisser all visible. Tabs: Historique, Sous-comptes, Cartes.

test_4_promo_banner.details: Promo banner displays on homepage. Shows '10 pourcent de réduction' with code 'ACTOOS10'. Console confirms: '✅ Promos chargées depuis Supabase: 5'. Carousel with 5 dots visible.

test_5_promo_code_checkout.details: PromoCodeInput component works at checkout. Toggle button (data-testid='promo-code-toggle') expands input. Suggested codes shown: ACTOOS10, LIVGRATUITE, BIENVENUE, LIVRAISON. Applied ACTOOS10: 10% discount = -350 FCFA. Total reduced from 4,400 to 4,050 FCFA.
